text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me... Cheer up, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But they were counting on me, and I<n>wasn't able to
follow through...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, yes... kind of.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Nishino Flower was<n>asked to embroider
a floral design<n>onto a handkerchief as a gift for her
friend's mother.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I used the wrong color, but I only<n>realized it after I
had already started<n>embroidering...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... What do I do? My friendasks me for help, and I end up ruiningeverything...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there, it's okay. I've got an<n>idea.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If we add a pattern using the color<n>you accidentally
used, it'll make a<n>nice background for the actual
flower...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-wow! This looks great!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Creek! You really<n>are
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're always so calm and kind—not<n>to mention
knowledgeable about all<n>sorts of things...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I still have a long way to go if Iever want to catch up to you...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wish I was as calm, dependable,<n>and wonderful
an Umamusume as<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, I'm sure you'll be far more<n>amazing than me
when you grow up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not true! I mean... I'm still...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, then I'll just have to prove it to<n>you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who grew those<n>flowers over there,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I love flowers too, but I don't know<n>very much
about them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Raising things is very difficult. Simply<n>liking them
isn't enough to make<n>them grow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
One needs knowledge, patience, and<n>a kind
heart—all of which you have,<n>Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And you'll become even more<n>wonderful from here
on out. There's<n>no need to rush.
choice_data_list:
For now, you still have time to let yourself get
coddled.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
See? Even someone who helps<n>Umamusume grow
for a living says<n>so.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush. Take your time becoming<n>the
Umamusume you want to be,<n>okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Just like how you grow flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right! I won't rush. I'll take my time...<n>growing
myself!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's encouragement<n>makes Nishino
Flower break into a<n>smile reminiscent of a blooming
bud.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I feel like Super Creek might end<n>up coddling
me a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about we test that out?<n>Starting... with...
a... squeeeeeze! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is surprised by Super<n>Creek's hug,
but smiles happily<n>nonetheless.
